riverWater.why: boss 8 Nov: a soft round pond the river flows into as one body (the west lip overlaps Millrill's mouth at 5870-5915, y 1915-2012); the ground lane paints it as a smooth curve, banks only on the outer edge

roads.note: boss 8 Nov: the shore lane filled the old inlet; the loop now passes west of Millrill Pond (pond poly x 5900-6303, y 1748-2005) instead of under it; boss 8 Nov bridges: it crosses Millrill twice, each straight over one arched bridge (river-crossing-3 at y 1420, river-crossing-4 at x 5733-5772), never along the water
